spatial_claims.claim: KA, LC, ME, NG are parallelepipedal solids similar and similarly situated to one another, with AB, CD, EF, GH as corresponding sides
KA:LC is the ratio triplicate of AB:CD, and ME:NG is the ratio triplicate of EF:GH, by 11.33 applied to similar parallelepipeds
Solid PO is constructed on line O, similar and similarly situated to ME, with side O corresponding to EF (by 11.27)
Faces of NG are similar to corresponding faces of PO (both being similar to faces of ME), so NG and PO are similar solids with GH and O as corresponding sides

configuration_map: AB, CD, EF, GH are four straight lines serving as corresponding sides of similar parallelepipedal solids KA, LC, ME, NG. The similarity relations are symmetric and transitive: KA ~ LC ~ ME ~ NG. In Part 2, O is a fourth proportional line (AB:CD = EF:O), and PO is a new solid constructed on O, similar to ME. The auxiliary magnitudes X, Y, Z, W, S, T are third proportionals used purely to express triplicate ratios and have no geometric position. The entire argument operates through ratio relationships between magnitudes; no points are placed inside or outside figures, no angles are decomposed, and no betweenness or ordering claims are made.
pass_reason: The proof is overwhelmingly proportional/algebraic. Its few spatial claims (similarity of parallelepipedal solids, corresponding sides, construction of a similar solid via 11.27, transitivity of face similarity via 6.21) are all mutually consistent. No angle decompositions, interior/exterior arguments, betweenness claims, or point-position claims are present that could produce a configuration contradiction.
